approach: Native Rust port of the decompiled game code, with the game data extracted to open formats at install
notes: Runs 100% in Rust: the graphical installer extracts the user's own disc into open formats (PNG, glTF, WAV, JSON) and installs a playable Tenkaichi3.exe. Player mode packs the data; developer mode keeps every file editable for mods. No game data is included in the repository.
